requiresRealMachineOrHuman.item: Tan's Huge Trees and TYG write-set certification
requiresRealMachineOrHuman.why: A profile with insufficient Tan's Huge Trees protection still refuses authorization, and the S5 full package stays BLOCKED. Recorded in docs/evidence/s1b/cross-cell/pre-fix-report.md line 133.
requiresRealMachineOrHuman.howToRunIt: Requires those mods present and their write sets certified. No method exists inside this repository.
requiresRealMachineOrHuman.thisIsARefusalNotAnUntestedPath: The block is implemented rather than pending: ProtectionSnapshot throws MISSING_FEATURES_PLAN when protection is captured before FEATURES completes and T0_CORRUPT on a snapshot hash mismatch, and OwnershipGuard throws on a write to a protected block. The source also records that no mod was deleted to fake compatibility - removing Tan's Huge Trees would have made the package load, and that was declined.
requiresRealMachineOrHuman.whyThatDistinctionMatters: An entry saying only 'blocked' reads the same whether the block is a deliberate refusal or an untested path. This one is the former.
